steps.what: Collaborate in research studies by contributing clinical knowledge and coordinating agreed study activities

tasks.design: Retain the midwife's substantive study collaboration using current protocol material in {DOCS} and agreed work in {PROJECT}. No unspecified literature, transcription or data-entry share is assumed to disappear.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research collaboration depends on clinical judgement, protocol meaning and agreement with the study team.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared records and communications support collaboration; no new generic research automation is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Protocol deviations, participant context and uncertain observations require human discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Bring clinical context to the research question and recognise when a study instruction does not fit observed circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Research contribution and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify study responsibilities and protocol questions

evidence.claim: Substantive study collaboration is retained; the digest's clinical documentation and registry capabilities do not establish a labour saving across this broad research task.

assumptions: Boundary is the focal midwife's actual agreed research contribution, not the entire study or invented generic administration. Other study staff's existing work stays outside and unchanged.

Study investigator and existing governance process produce current protocol, delegated responsibilities and required study permissions before related study activity. Midwife clarifies source/version, task scope, participant context and uncertainties within retained100 hours. Any study observations are produced during the relevant authorised activity before interpretation or discussion of those results. No free clean-study-dataset, participant-eligible or protocol-compliant flag is assumed; gaps use existing investigator clarification and study procedures.
Use native controlled-document and project facilities before custom code; no new automated research decision or extra participant capture is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because study workflow and tools are unchanged.
unknowns: Actual research activities and delegated responsibilities
Whether a distinct repeatable clerical task exists
research_questions: Which concrete activities make up the midwife's study contribution, and is any repeated clerical operation separate from substantive collaboration?

already_counted.description: Clinical research contribution, protocol clarification and collaboration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Without a defined repeated subtask, substantive research collaboration retains time; other staff effort and study waiting are not labour savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Study collaboration retains its time and clinical contribution.
reach: Clarify protocol responsibilities with clinical research coordinators
role.ambitious_version: A midwife who contributes clinical insight to studies while keeping protocol responsibilities and evidence limits clear.
